idea-plugin.name: PortPilot
idea-plugin.description:
Something is already running on port 3000. PortPilot tells you what, which of your projects it belongs to, which coding agent started it (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider, …), whether it is healthy, and lets you stop it.

  • A PortPilot tool window with this project's ports, or every port on the machine.
  • Processes that an ended agent session left behind, with one-click clean-up.
  • Open in browser, show output, check health, copy URL or PID, stop the process (it asks first).
  • A status-bar widget with this project's ports and leftovers.

Uses the portpilot terminal app (Linux, macOS, Windows) from github.com/Atrix21/port-pilot.
